messages:
maria: Heads-up — we're doing the prod cutover for the routing change tonight at 02:00 UTC. Need owners for the window, smoke checks, and rollback. CS/Marketing, please confirm you can ship notes.
lee: I can own the cutover window and watch metrics (02:00-03:00). I'll be on the pager. :white_check_mark:
ryan: I'll run the smoke suite and report results. Plan: quick smoke then deeper run if green. Command I’ll use:
```
./tools/smoke/run_smoke.sh --env prod --quick --report ./tmp/smoke-$(date +%s).json
```
dan: Rollback plan is to flip the feature gate back and re-route traffic to v2. Quick command to revert feature flag:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" 
  https://internal-api.redwood/v1/feature-gates/route_v3/revert 
  -d '{"reason":"rollback from cutover"}'
```
sasha: I'll update the release notes and the internal KB. Will open PR to central-releases repo now and tag @ana_marketing.
nana_marketing: (ana_marketing) Got it — marketing will prepare the customer email and one-pager. Can we aim for a short blurb by 01:30 UTC so we can schedule at 02:15?
cs_lead: CS will staff the rotation 02:00-03:00. I'll put canned responses in the CS playbook. @maria please paste the short customer blurb here.
maria: Blurb: "Today we rolled out inference routing improvements that reduce tail latency for embeddings endpoints and improve throughput for short sequences. No action required from customers; please report any issues to support."
infra_oncall: I'll be standing by for the cutover. Quick checklist from infra side: healthchecks for workers, autoscaler metrics, disk usage. If error-rate > 1% for 5m, I'll trigger fallback to v2. @lee please ensure the canary traffic target is set to 5% initially.
lee: Canary set to 5% and will move to 25% at 02:10 if metrics look good. I'll post metric screenshots in this thread.
deploy-bot: Reminder: run the canary deploy using the deploy tool and mark the canary as "observing". Command: `deploy tool canary --service routing --tag v3 --pct 5`
ryan: After smoke (expected ~4m) I'll paste the smoke summary and attach the report link.
sasha: PR for release notes: https://github.com/redwood/central-releases/pull/482 — requesting review from @maria and @ana_marketing.
cs_lead: Added canned FAQs to the playbook and linked to the PR. Quick snippet for CS: "If customers notice higher latency, ask for request IDs and escalate to infra."
maria: Thanks. Quick Q: who will own rollback if we need a config revert vs code rollback?
dan: I'll own the config revert (feature gate). If we need a code rollback, infra_oncall + lee coordinate and I'll assist.
lee: I'll signal for rollback in #eng-oncall and post steps here.
maria: Great. I'll ping everyone 15m before and set a calendar invite for the 02:00 UTC window. Please confirm you're good.
nana_marketing: Confirmed.
cs_lead: Confirmed.
ryan: Confirmed — will be by my laptop.
d an: Confirmed.
infra_oncall: Confirmed.
lee: Confirmed.
deploy-bot: Scheduled reminder at 01:45 UTC for the canary start.
maria: Perfect — closing the loop. If anything changes, update this thread and tag @maria. Thanks all. :rocket:
